title: Representation estimate for a test form h·θ whose coefficient vanishes off W and on K: |T(hθ)| ≤ c·c'·μ(W∖K) (Step 7(b) of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, W, K ⊆ ℝ^P with W open and K compact. Let T ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), let μ be a measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) n) with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ: for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U), x ↦ ξ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x). Assume μ(W∖K) ≠ ∞. Let θ ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n, h : ℝ^P → ℝ and c, c' ∈ ℝ satisfy: |h(x)| ≤ c for every x; h(x) = 0 for every x ∉ W; h(x) = 0 for every x ∈ K; and |ξ(x)(θ)| ≤ c' for μ-a.e. x. Then every φ ∈ Dⁿ(U) with φ(x) = h(x)·θ for all x satisfies |T(φ)| ≤ c·c'·μ(W∖K), where μ(W∖K) is read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W K : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → IsOpen W → IsCompact K → μ (W \ K) ≠ ∞ → ∀ (θ : Covector (Eucl P) n) (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (c c' : ℝ), (∀ x, |h x| ≤ c) → (∀ x, x ∉ W → h x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ K, h x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |ξ x θ| ≤ c') → ∀ φ : TestFormOn U n, (∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = h x • θ) → |T φ| ≤ c * c' * (μ (W \ K)).toReal
